name: Gaming chair
definition: a desk chair styled on a racing seat, with high back, headrest and lumbar cushions, tilting and reclining, made for long sessions at a computer.
notes: Best Buy keeps gaming chairs as its own category apart from office chairs

name: Floating shelf
definition: a shelf fixed to a wall with hidden brackets so that no support shows.
notes: Shelfology keeps Floating Shelves as its own collection

name: Corner shelf
definition: a wall shelf shaped to fit the inside or outside corner of two walls.

name: Picture ledge
definition: a narrow wall shelf with a front lip, made to stand framed pictures and small objects on.
